name: Clerk
subtitle: Hosted user management with drop-in UI
creator: Colin and Braden Sidoti
description: A hosted service that gives you pre-built sign-in and sign-up components, user profiles, organizations for B2B apps, MFA, passkeys and session management. You add a provider and components instead of building auth screens yourself. It bills retained users, meaning people who come back 24 hours or more after signing up.
useCases: B2B apps that need organizations and roles
Getting production auth running in minutes

languages.written: SDKs in TypeScript, Go, Python, Ruby and more

concepts.explanation: Wraps your app and supplies session context.
Middleware or proxy decides who can see what.
Read the signed-in user on the server.
Short-lived JWTs verified on each request.
Sync users into your own database.

codeSamples.label: TSX · Next.js server component

pairsWith.reason: JWT integration with Row Level Security

pros: Generous free tier of 50,000 retained users
cons: Vendor lock-in: user data lives in Clerk
Costs rise with scale and add-ons
Less control over flows than self-hosting
Depends on a third party's uptime

pricing.summary: Hobby: free up to 50,000 monthly retained users per app. Pro: $25/mo ($20/mo billed annually), then $0.02 per extra retained user. Business: $300/mo. Enterprise: custom.
